causal_clock.entry: first 5-minute open strictly after completed signal hour
causal_clock.protective_stop: after price first advances 1% favorably, move stop to entry price beginning with the next 5-minute bar only
causal_clock.regime_threshold: Q60 of preceding 756 finite RV20 observations strictly before t
causal_clock.rv20: sqrt(365*mean(r_d^2)) using calendar-day returns t-20 through t-1

contamination.claim: contamination-aware sequential pre-2024 selection freeze; this protective execution was selected using train only; 2024 and later values were not inspected for this variant
contamination.successor_change: freeze the strongest pre-2024 low-participation shock-reversal cell at 1x and add one causal risk-control rule: after 1% favorable excursion, breakeven stop becomes active on the next 5m bar

mechanism: In a causally known high-volatility regime, extreme low-participation directional shocks are faded at the next 5m open. Once the reversal has moved 1% favorably, a next-bar-only breakeven stop prevents a recovered liquidation shock from becoming a full-loss retracement without same-bar lookahead.

path_accounting.protective_stop_order: the stop fixed before each bar is checked adverse-first; favorable excursion on a bar may arm breakeven only for the following bar

persistent_long_vol_control.definition: Q75 RV20 daily long at identical gross
persistent_long_vol_control.gate: normal+stress residual positive in train, 2024, each future, combined

selection.future: single fixed cell/1x/weight only; no rerank, repair, rank2, leverage or protective-stop change
selection.weight_selection: 2024 only; maximize same-gross CAGR/MDD improvement subject to all confirmation gates
